observations: Black treadle sewing machine with a cast-iron stand.
The machine head is visible with a handwheel and needle bar.
The treadle stand features a foot pedal and decorative cast iron legs.
No brand name, model number, or manufacturing date is legible on the machine or stand.
The background is a plain white studio setting, suggesting a stock or catalog photo.

claims.evidence: The photo appears to be a professional stock image, not a photo of the actual item in a home environment.
No Singer logo or nameplate is visible in the photo.
The photo shows only the machine and stand; accessories like bobbins or foot pedal may be missing.
The machine is not shown powered on or in operation.

risks.risk: The machine may not sew or may have mechanical defects.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine sewing through fabric.

risks.risk: Essential accessories like the foot pedal, bobbins, or presser foot may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of all included accessories.

risks.risk: The brand may not be Singer, which significantly affects value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand name and model on the machine head or the underside of the treadle stand.
risks.if_unproven: as an unbranded or generic treadle machine

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine sewing a piece of fabric to demonstrate it works.
Photo of all included accessories (foot pedal, bobbins, presser foot).
Photo of the underside of the treadle stand to check for a brand name or model number.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
